'''Xolu''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Xolu system/Legends|Xolu system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was connected to the worlds of [[Hollastin]] and [[Far Pando]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Pando Spur/Legends|Pando Spur]].<ref name="TEA" />

Xolu was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Yahk-Tosh]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that had pledged fealty to the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]], the ruling [[Politics/Legends|political]] body of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species.<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was considered important to the Hutt [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] culture.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Xolu was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square S-13.<ref name="TEA" />
